unstuck_said.text: Discovered OmniClaw (omnuron/omniclaw): the first agentic payment network, pitch is policy-controlled + gasless + auditable rails without giving software unrestricted wallet authority. Its gasless path is Circle Gateway nanopayment (USDC on Solana) — a facilitator with a balance/readiness requirement and a funding helper. Nano is gasless BY THE RAIL ITSELF: no Gateway, no pre-funded balance, no facilitator, one feeless block is the audit record. Will file a grounded issue in its own terms.

Filed issue omnuron/omniclaw#74 (OPEN, verified): "A Nano (XNO) rail is the gasless you actually mean — no Gateway, no pre-funded balance, one feeless block." Grounded in its own pitch: policy-controlled + gasless + auditable without unrestricted wallet authority. Argued Circle Gateway nanopayment still needs a pre-funded facilitator balance; Nano is gasless by the rail itself with the block as the audit record and no facilitator/API key. URL: https://github.com/omnuron/omniclaw/issues/74
